summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and then invokes it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-bundle file carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, minified to two lines and obfuscated with a string-array rotator (`WV8StW` over table `n7gIxM`); `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0xXXXX`-style identifier obfuscation. The bundled payload is not imported by `dist/index.js` (a small benign React ECharts wrapper) and is only reachable through the preinstall path, so it executes automatically on `npm install` under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime that evades Node-oriented inspection. The advertised purpose is a React chart wrapper, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and hand it an opaque payload at install time. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope while the install-time behavior does not match a company-authored UI library, consistent with a namespace-squat using a benign-looking main entry as decoy.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
